name: Somchai Srisuk
bio:
Somchai's fascination with motorsport began during his university days, fueled by late-night viewings of Formula 1 races. After graduating with a degree in mechanical engineering, he sought opportunities to combine his technical skills with his passion for racing. He started in a small engineering firm specializing in automotive simulations, quickly proving his aptitude for translating real-world data into accurate virtual models. His dedication to improving simulator fidelity and driver experience led him to United Autosports.

At United Autosports, Somchai focuses on fine-tuning the simulator environment to provide drivers with the most realistic training possible. He meticulously analyzes telemetry data, tracks environmental conditions, and collaborates closely with drivers and race engineers to create an immersive and effective simulation experience. He believes the simulator is more than just a game; it's a vital tool for driver development and race strategy optimization. Somchai's approachable demeanor and commitment to continuous improvement make him a valuable asset to the team.

What sets Somchai apart is his ability to blend technical expertise with a practical understanding of racing dynamics. He consistently seeks feedback from drivers and engineers, using their insights to refine the simulator's performance and create a more realistic and valuable training tool. His deep understanding of vehicle dynamics and his dedication to continuous improvement make him an invaluable asset to the team.
